name: Fibra Mty, S.A.P.I. de C.V.
summary: Fibra Mty, S.A.P.I. de C.V. is a real estate investment trust that initiated operations on December 11, 2014 identified by the number F/2157, and also as Fibra Mty or FMTY. Fibra Mty's strategy is based mainly on the acquisition, administration, development, and operation of corporate properties in Mexico. Fibra Mty is a FIBRA qualified as a transparent entity under Mexican Income Tax laws; therefore, all revenues derived from Fibra Mty's operation are attributable to the holders of its CBFIs, given that Trust 2157 is not subject to Income Tax in Mexico.
